responsibility: Declares the small shared Tree SSA utility interface used by passes that manipulate SSA form and CFG edges. It defines the edge_var_map structure carried on redirected edges for deferred PHI argument updates, exposes helpers to redirect edges, flush pending statements, replace SSA-definition LHSs while preserving debug information, initialize and tear down per-function tree-SSA state, verify SSA consistency, query or mark default-def and maybe-undefined SSA names, and trigger address-taken recomputation, making it the common pass-facing header for generic SSA maintenance rather than for SSA_NAME allocation details.
same_name_distinction: This header is the common declaration surface for generic Tree SSA maintenance utilities, exposing edge_var_map, edge-redirection helpers, SSA verification/init hooks, maybe-undef queries, and address-taken update entry points. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa.cc, it does not implement those shared utilities.
